title: type or port
symptoms: The existing parser reports type_or_port at the recorded tool stage
possible_causes: An instance names an absent port
The positional argument count differs from the module declaration
A signal width or type differs from its interface
inspection_steps: Compare the instance connections with the declared module interface
Check width, direction and signedness before changing expressions
repair_guidance: Correct only the inconsistent DUT connection or expression; preserve the trusted interface
limitations: A port diagnostic does not prove that every connected value is functionally correct
